snippet: I've dictated almost everything for 6 months with Wispr Flow. 44,414 words, 161 wpm, top 0.1% of users. Last week I tried FluidVoice. Open source, runs local on my Mac, corrects as I speak with no…
content_text: [1/27 @sdhilip] I've dictated almost everything for 6 months with Wispr Flow. 44,414 words, 161 wpm, top 0.1% of users. Last week I tried FluidVoice. Open source, runs local on my Mac, corrects as I speak with no API key, and handles slang better than I expected. Cancelled my paid plan. If you're on a Mac, this one's for you: https://t.co/tCij9UroGs @ALTIC_DEV --- [2/27 @ALTIC_DEV] @sdhilip This genuinely made my day :,)) Posts like this make last 4 months of sleepless nights, and research to give the best output worth it. --- [3/27 @sdhilip] @ALTIC_DEV Really good product --- [4/27 @NishantRArora] @sdhilip Try Spokenly, also free but super polished compared to FluidVoice. --- [5/27 @sdhilip] @NishantRArora Will check --- [6/27 @gvkhna] @sdhilip Founder is very active responding to feedback and bugs. This is core infra now. --- [7/27 @sdhilip] @gvkhna Yeah true --- [8/27 @thattallguy] @sdhilip Is it really comparable though? Have tired a few others and whisperflow just had fewer rough edges and was worth the few dollars a month. Consider me twice bitten once shy. --- [9/27 @sdhilip] @thattallguy Better than Wispr flow as per my experience --- [10/27 @akibablade] @sdhilip Bro i did 45k on the free trial --- [11/27 @sdhilip] @akibablade That’s amazing mate --- [12/27 @KongBTC] @sdhilip Local and no API key is the killer feature right there --- [13/27 @sdhilip] @KongBTC yeah true mate --- [14/27 @TheThomHart] @sdhilip There's also https://t.co/BIjQmfRIu3 on iOS and Mac.
